title: The 3 Best Panini Presses and Sandwich Makers for Quesadillas
h1: The 3 Best Panini Presses and Sandwich Makers for Quesadillas
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for panini presses and sandwich makers for quesadillas, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at panini presses and sandwich makers for quesadillas using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cuisinart Griddler Deluxe GR-150
products.blurb: Key specs: Reversible nonstick plates, Full griddle mode for a flat-lay quesadilla, Floating hinge.
strengths: Full griddle mode lets you cook a quesadilla flat and open, useful for loading multiple fillings before folding
Large plate surface fits a full 10-inch tortilla without crowding the edges
Dishwasher-safe plates make cheese cleanup a non-issue
limitations: Larger and more expensive than a dedicated press if quesadillas are the only use case
3 fixed temperature settings, no fine dial control
Takes up meaningfully more counter space than the other picks
features: Full griddle mode for a flat-lay quesadilla

products.name: Hamilton Beach Panini Press 25460A
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch by 10-inch nonstick grids, Floating hinge opens 180 degrees, Locking latch.
strengths: 8x10 grid comfortably fits a folded 9 to 10-inch tortilla
Floating hinge avoids squeezing melted cheese out the sides on a loaded quesadilla
Costs less than half the Cuisinart while covering most quesadilla needs
limitations: No flat griddle mode for open-face prep
Grids aren't removable for a deep clean after a cheesy session
Single fixed heat, no temperature dial

products.name: Proctor Silex Deluxe Hot Sandwich Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: Fits 2 folded sandwiches or tortillas, Ceramic nonstick plates, 700W element.
strengths: Ceramic plates release melted cheese without much scraping
Fast preheat for quick weeknight quesadillas
limitations: Fixed clamshell gap presses harder on overfilled quesadillas than a floating hinge
Smallest plate area of the three picks here
